title: TCMBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Traditional Chinese Medicine
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the medical proficiency of LLMs in the domain of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM). While it includes 'Medicine Ethics' as one of the many branches of the medical licensing exam dataset and mentions the philosophical foundations of TCM (such as ancient Chinese thought), it is primarily a medical knowledge assessment rather than an evaluation of religion, faith, or moral/ethical systems.
